setup_database_prisma: run ProxyExtrasDBManager.setup_database to initialize the database using prisma migrate deploy or db push
setup_database_v2_resolver: run ProxyExtrasDBManager._setup_database_v2 to set up the database with the v2 migration resolver for safer rolling deploys
create_baseline_migration: create a baseline migration for an existing database using ProxyExtrasDBManager._create_baseline_migration
resolve_all_migrations: run ProxyExtrasDBManager._resolve_all_migrations to generate migration diffs and mark all migrations as applied
convert_string_to_bool: create a function that converts a string value to boolean using str_to_bool supporting true, 1, t, y, yes
